name: Huevos con chorizo
steps: Crumble the chorizo into a hot pan and render until the oil turns red.
Add the chopped onion and soften in the chorizo oil.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Pour the eggs into the pan and stir gently until softly scrambled.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan.
Spoon the eggs and chorizo into the tortillas and serve.
